item.description: The California State University San Bernardino Palm Desert Campus hosted a career showcase today aimed at connecting students with local employers across the Coachella Valley.The event ran from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. inside the campus’ Health Sciences Building on Cook Street. item.title: RIVERSIDE COUNTY INVESTIGATING CLAIMS OF VOTE COUNT DISCREPANCY IN 2025 SPECIAL ELECTION
item.description: New allegations about vote counting in Riverside County are drawing attention from law enforcement and county officials.A group of residents claims that thousands more ballots were counted than were actually cast during a statewide special election in November 2025. However, county election officials say the claims are based on misinterpreted data and that the actual difference in ballots is minimal.The allegations come from a local group calling itself the Riverside Election Integrity Team. item.title: Is Indio Cracking Down on Short-Term Rentals Harder Than the Rest of the Valley?
item.description: The city of Indio is moving forward with some of the strictest short-term rental regulations in the Coachella Valley, signaling a stronger push to address neighborhood concerns tied to vacation rentals. City leaders recently approved new rules that significantly increase penalties for violations and impose stricter oversight on property owners and management companies.Under the updated policy, the fine for a first offense will jump from $1,500 to $5,000. item.title: Why Are More Coachella Valley Families Struggling With Food and Health Care?
item.description: A newly released health report paints a concerning picture of the challenges facing many residents in the Coachella Valley. The report shows a significant increase in food insecurity, with more families relying on food banks or struggling to afford basic groceries as prices remain elevated.Rising food costs appear to be a major factor. item.description: A new policy from United Airlines is drawing attention to a common annoyance many travelers experience during flights: passengers playing audio out loud from their phones. item.title: Lady Arabs advance to CIF State Regional Final with a 4-1 win over Segerstrom
item.description: The Coachella Valley High School Lady Arabs soccer team continues to make history as the dream season lives to see another game.Down 1-0 at the half, Coachella Valley High School girls soccer came out on a mission and played flawlessly in the second half to get the victory. Lady Arabs had goals from Monica Ontiveros, Jaylynn Hernandez, Daniela Pineda and Milagros Gamboa.
